description: Header file defining the interface for managing initial resource values for device and endpoint resources, including creation, destruction, setting, getting, and logging functions.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of icInitialResourceValues.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesPutDeviceValue
methods.description: Sets or replaces an initial value for a device resource.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesPutDeviceValueIfNotExists
methods.description: Sets an initial value for a device resource only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesPutEndpointValue
methods.description: Sets or replaces an initial value for an endpoint resource.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesPutEndpointValueIfNotExists
methods.description: Sets an initial value for an endpoint resource only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesHasDeviceValue
methods.description: Checks if a device resource has an initial value set.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesHasEndpointValue
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint resource has an initial value set.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesGetDeviceValue
methods.description: Retrieves the initial value for a device resource.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesGetEndpointValue
methods.description: Retrieves the initial value for an endpoint resource.

methods.name: initialResourcesValuesLogValues
methods.description: Logs all set initial resource values.
